## Purpose and Entry Points
Now in Android is a modular Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android reference app for browsing Android-development news, following topics, bookmarking content, searching, and receiving matching-content notifications. The primary installable app starts through `app/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/NiaApplication.kt` and `app/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/MainActivity.kt`, which renders the root Compose shell in `app/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/ui/NiaApp.kt`. `app-nia-catalog` is a separate component-catalog application, entered by `app-nia-catalog/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/niacatalog/NiaCatalogActivity.kt`.

## Application Shell and Navigation
The app module owns process-level Hilt setup, activity lifecycle integration, adaptive app state, top-level navigation, theme selection, and app-wide performance instrumentation. `MainActivityViewModel.kt` prepares startup/UI state; `NiaAppState.kt` coordinates navigation and window/layout concerns. Navigation is abstracted behind `core/navigation/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/navigation/Navigator.kt` and `NavigationState.kt`, keeping feature destinations decoupled from the app shell.

## Feature Boundaries
User-facing capabilities are split into API and implementation modules. API modules expose typed navigation keys; implementation modules supply Compose entry providers, screens, and ViewModels. Representative paths are:
- For You/onboarding feed: `feature/foryou/api/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/foryou/api/navigation/ForYouNavKey.kt`, `feature/foryou/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/foryou/impl/ForYouViewModel.kt`.
- Interests and topic detail: `feature/interests/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/interests/impl/InterestsScreen.kt`, `feature/topic/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/topic/impl/TopicViewModel.kt`.
- Bookmarks and search: `feature/bookmarks/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/bookmarks/impl/BookmarksViewModel.kt`, `feature/search/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/feature/search/impl/SearchViewModel.kt`.
Settings is a dialog-oriented feature backed by persisted user preferences.

## Data, Domain, and Persistence Flow
Features consume repository interfaces and domain use cases, producing observable UI state in ViewModels. Shared business models live in `core/model/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/model/data/`. Search and topic-following orchestration is isolated in use cases such as `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/domain/GetSearchContentsUseCase.kt`. The data layer implements offline-first repositories—e.g., `core/data/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/data/repository/OfflineFirstNewsRepository.kt` and `OfflineFirstUserDataRepository.kt`—which bridge network sync, Room, DataStore preferences, connectivity, and analytics.

Room is the local content/search cache via `core/database/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/database/NiaDatabase.kt` and its DAOs. Proto DataStore persists theme, followed topics, bookmarks, and sync versions through `core/datastore/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/datastore/NiaPreferencesDataSource.kt` and `core/datastore-proto/src/main/proto/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/data/user_preferences.proto`.

## External Boundaries and Background Work
`core/network` defines `NiaNetworkDataSource.kt`; the demo flavor serves bundled `news.json`/`topics.json`, while production uses `RetrofitNiaNetwork.kt` against a non-public backend. Flavor-specific bindings select these implementations. WorkManager schedules and executes synchronization through `sync/work/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/sync/workers/SyncWorker.kt` and `WorkManagerSyncManager.kt`. Production can subscribe to Firebase-driven sync events and display notification updates. Firebase Analytics is similarly production-bound in `core/analytics/src/prod/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/analytics/FirebaseAnalyticsHelper.kt`; `app/google-services.json` configures Google services.

## UI System and Dependency Composition
Compose screens depend on shared visual primitives and feed components rather than direct platform UI: `core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/designsystem/theme/Theme.kt`, `core/ui/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/core/ui/NewsFeed.kt`. Hilt modules at data/database/network boundaries bind interfaces to flavor-specific implementations, enabling demo, production, and test substitutions.

## Build, Delivery, and Performance
Gradle convention plugins centralize Android, Compose, Hilt, Room, flavor, and quality policy under `build-logic/convention/src/main/kotlin/`. Main variants are `demo` (bundled data), `prod` (remote backend), plus `benchmark`; normal development targets `demoDebug`. Macrobenchmarks and baseline-profile journeys reside in `benchmarks/src/main/kotlin/com/google/samples/apps/nowinandroid/baselineprofile/` and support startup and critical navigation optimization. GitHub Actions build, release, and nightly profile workflows are in `.github/workflows/`.
